theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  have hrec : ∀ m : ℕ, (u (m + 4) : ℝ) =
      ((u (m + 3) + u (m + 2) + u (m + 1) * u m : ℝ) /
        (u (m + 3) * u (m + 2) + u (m + 1) + u m)) :=
    fun m => (hu (m + 4) (by omega)).1
  let f : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hfin : Set.Finite (Set.range f) :=
    Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)))
      (by rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩; simp [f, Finset.mem_Icc, Set.mem_Icc, hB])
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! hc
    exact (Set.not_infinite.mpr hfin)
      (Set.infinite_range_of_injective fun a b hab => by
        rcases lt_trichotomy a b with k | k | k <;> simp_all)
  have ht : ∀ k : ℕ, (u (i + k), u (i + k + 1), u (i + k + 2), u (i + k + 3))
      = (u (j + k), u (j + k + 1), u (j + k + 2), u (j + k + 3)) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simpa using h
    | succ k ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
      refine ⟨h2, h3, h4, (Int.cast_inj (R := ℝ)).mp ?_⟩
      rw [show (i + k.succ + 3) = i + k + 4 from rfl, show (j + k.succ + 3) = j + k + 4 from rfl,
        hrec (i + k), hrec (j + k), h1, h2, h3, h4]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, by omega, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have h2 : i + (n - i) = n := by omega
  rw [← h2]
  rw [show j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) from by omega]
  exact congr_arg Prod.fst (ht (n - i))
